libs.note: BH-9677 (BH-9334.3). The two timeouts of the key probe bin/load-project.sh --claude-auth api-key runs before it writes the claude_auth / runner_lock rows: one fly ssh console call on the project's Fly app (bin/lib/vendor/fly-anthropic-probe.sh) that sends one GET /v1/models. Resolved through lib_env_apply load-project-key-probe in a subshell. A value outside min..max is refused (rc 2), never clamped. tests/load-project-claude-auth.bh-9677-test.sh drives it.

knobs.note: curl -m on the Fly machine for the GET /v1/models call. The same as SECRETS_APPLY_PROBE_TIMEOUT_S; the call answers in under 2 s. Read by bin/load-project.sh as ${LOAD_PROJECT_KEY_PROBE_TIMEOUT_S:-30}.
The whole fly ssh console call, machine start included (a stopped Fly machine can need about 60 s). Read by bin/load-project.sh as ${LOAD_PROJECT_KEY_PROBE_SSH_TIMEOUT_S:-120}.
